releaseNotes: All twelve tutorial explanations now sit a consistent 14 px from their highlighted cut-out.
Cut-out corners follow the actual UI component shape instead of using one radius for every element.
My Week tutorial step one now explains tapping days to manage lunch or dinner and choose a meal.
The guided tour does not insert a toothpaste example into shopping data and preserves genuine user-added items.
Navigation tabs, shopping guidance, Skip, replay and saved meal plans continue working as before.
